Both sides of the origin/main merge appended ONE quad after a user wrapper's method pointers:
this branch the byte offset of a declared `public $context;`, upstream a bitmask of the slots
whose method returns a boxed Mixed. The merge kept the mask — correctly, since every helper that
reads that address reads a mask — but `fopen` went on reading the SAME address as the context
offset.

What the quad happens to hold then decides the behaviour, which is why the symptom looked
arbitrary:
